verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents an extensive API/SDK surface (search, filtering, indexing, versioning, branching, security, storage) but never mentions or compares against a graphical UI/dashboard, so there is no evidence establishing UI/API parity one way or the other. Missing for 10: any mention of a LanceDB UI/console, and any explicit claim or demonstration that all UI-accessible actions are also exposed via API.
